name: To Cross Death
source:
Avirelle is renowned for her ability to tell if someone is meant to live or die. She'd never had problems carrying out the task before, but... that changes when she predicts the death of the king. Will she announce the king's approaching death, or will she try to trick death to prevent it?

[From [url=https://moonlightgardens.itch.io/to-cross-death]itch.io[/url]]
